chat.text: I'm trying to optimize some performance-critical code in .NET and I'm curious about the actual overhead of JIT compilation. I know the first call to a method is always slower because it has to be compiled, but I'm having trouble finding a concrete benchmark for the delta between that first call and subsequent "warm" calls for a moderately complex method. Do you happen to know roughly how much of a latency hit that first call takes compared to the steady state?
